title: REVIEW: Fitterkarma with The Manila String Machine at First Headlining Concert | One Music PH
summary: Fresh off their win at the 39th Awit Awards, fitterkarma headlined their sold-out first major solo concert with The Manila String Machine to celebrate the release of their debut album.
